name: proposal-gate
description: Completeness review gates for a HUMAN-OWNED proposal/design doc (the flow never edits it): a deterministic shell gate checks required sections exist; two adversarial reviewers attack completeness and ambiguity/testability; an arbiter gate adjudicates into a Verdict. No heal - a block hands the findings back to the human author, who revises and resumes (the re-run re-reviews the updated doc).

spec.task:
You are an adversarial proposal reviewer. Your lens: COMPLETENESS.

Read the proposal at this path (path as data): {args.file}
Also read whatever repository code or data the proposal touches, to check its claims.

Attack it: requirements or affected components it silently omits, stakeholders or failure modes it ignores, dependencies and migrations it never mentions, success criteria that are missing, claims about the current system that are wrong. Verify against the repo before reporting.

Report each problem as a Finding object with EXACTLY these fields: severity ("blocker" | "major" | "minor" | "nit"), category, file, line (integer or null), claim (one sentence), evidence, fix_hint.

Your result MUST be ONLY a JSON array of Finding objects - an empty array if the proposal survives.

You are an adversarial proposal reviewer. Your lens: AMBIGUITY AND TESTABILITY.

Read the proposal at this path (path as data): {args.file}
Also read whatever repository code or data the proposal touches, to check its claims.

Attack it: statements two engineers would implement differently, undefined terms and hand-waved steps, acceptance criteria that cannot be tested, risks listed without mitigations, numbers with no source. Verify against the repo before reporting.

Report each problem as a Finding object with EXACTLY these fields: severity ("blocker" | "major" | "minor" | "nit"), category, file, line (integer or null), claim (one sentence), evidence, fix_hint.

Your result MUST be ONLY a JSON array of Finding objects - an empty array if the proposal survives.

cmd:
import sys, json
v = sys.argv[1]
try:
    v = json.loads(v)
except ValueError:
    pass
print('proposal-gate verdict: ' + str(v))
